payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about various baseline models used in speech translation experiments, including their configurations and training methods.

claims.text: The baselines include a vanilla ST model, pre-training baselines (encoder, decoder, and encoder-decoder pre-training), and multi-task baselines (one-to-many, many-to-one, and many-to-many settings).
The vanilla ST baseline consists of a speech encoder and decoder trained from scratch on the ST-TED corpus.
Pre-training baselines involve initializing the ST encoder from an ASR model and the decoder from an MT model, with different training datasets.
Multi-task baselines include experiments with different configurations such as one-to-many and many-to-many settings.
